updates.content:
Title: Some users aren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users weren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

Current status: We've investigated a problem with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in which users aren't able to upload new skills, and we’ve confirmed that service is now restored. We'll provide additional information in a closure summary within the “History” section of the “Service health” dashboard shortly.

Title: Some users aren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users weren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

Final status: We identified that a recent service-side update resulted in the inability to upload new skills. We've applied a targeted code change to correct this issue and have confirmed through service-side reproduction that the issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Your organization was impacted, and some users weren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. 

Start time: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

End time: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 11:40 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent service-side update resulted in this impacting event.

Next steps: 
- We'll continue to review our update approval process to better help prevent future similar events.

This is the final update for this event.
